stem: Why is a normal stop button insufficient proof that equipment is safe to service?
choices: Hazardous or stored energy and unexpected startup may remain unless the employer-defined energy-control procedure is completed.
Servicing safety depends only on how long the equipment has been off.
rationale: Hazardous or stored energy and unexpected startup may remain unless the employer-defined energy-control procedure is completed. This preserves the evidence and role boundary required by the referenced verification framework.
